name: Yearling: Keep Your Resolution
subtitle: One resolution. Three habits.
promotionalText: Make one resolution. Yearling turns it into three small habits with a plan, fills them in from Apple Health, and lets each one fly once it sticks.
description:
Make one resolution. Yearling turns it into a plan you can keep.

Most New Year's resolutions are vague, framed as something to stop, and abandoned after one bad week. Yearling is built around the few things that research says help: a specific plan, a "start" instead of a "stop", habits small enough to repeat, and a fresh start instead of a broken streak.

ONE RESOLUTION, THREE SMALL HABITS
• Pick a common resolution (move more, sleep better, feel calmer, read more, evenings off the phone…) or write your own.
• Yearling suggests up to three small habits that add up to it. Never more than three.
• Wrote "stop scrolling in bed"? Yearling suggests a version about starting something, because those are kept more often.

A PLAN FOR EVERY HABIT
• Tie each habit to something you already do: "After lunch: walk 6,000 steps."
• Reminders lead with your plan and stop as soon as the habit is done.

DONE FOR YOU, FROM APPLE HEALTH
• Walking, exercise, sleep, mindful minutes, water, daylight, standing and workouts fill in by themselves. No logging.
• See your last 30 days the moment you add a habit, and start from a goal you can reach.
• Anything else is one tap: in the app, on a widget, the Lock Screen, Control Center or with Siri.

HABITS THAT FLY, A RESOLUTION THAT'S KEPT
• A habit can graduate from day 30, once you've met it on 80% of days. It leaves your list and keeps tracking quietly.
• When every habit has flown, your resolution is kept.
• Write a note to your December self. It stays sealed until 1 December, or the day your resolution is kept.

FRESH STARTS, NOT FAILURES
• Your first week has its own view, because the first days matter most.
• Missed a day? Today keeps it on track. A quiet week? Monday is a fresh start, with the same plan or smaller steps.
• No red screens, no points, no guilt. Start a resolution any Monday or 1st of the month, not just on New Year's Day.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• No account. Apple Health data, your resolution and your letter stay on your device and are never uploaded.

EVERYWHERE YOU LOOK
• Home Screen widgets in every size, Lock Screen widgets, StandBy, Control Center and Siri. Native on iPad, too.

YEARLING PRO
Free includes your resolution, three habits and one habit filled in from Apple Health. Pro lets all three fill in by themselves and adds every widget size, the Lock Screen widgets, app icons and CSV export. Yearly with a 7-day free trial, monthly, or once for life.
